description: Highly elliptical, Molniya-like (conditioning near perigee). Zero Δv at m = 42706 s vs the coast run, ≈ 10 periods.
status: Committed before any engine run on it (tolerances.md §4.1 item 1; ML-TASK-018 part C phase 1). Not yet reviewed or approved; immutable once approved, corrections create a new version (plan §6).

inputs.requestIdNote: requestId = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(UTF-8(canonicalRequestPayload(request)))) per contracts-v1.md §7.1, computed with @mission-lab/contracts canonicalRequestPayload and Node crypto SHA-256 (test code only).

model.constantsSource: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)
model.units: SI: m, m/s, s, rad, m³/s²

references: L1 (the coast run of the same engine)
producedBy.independence: packages/astrodynamics and packages/simulation not read and not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value; JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0) except where a value is encoded as {"$number": "-0"}.

method.exactParts: deltaV_inertial_mps components === 0 (±0 allowed); velocityAfter_mps[i] === velocityBefore_mps[i] (tolerances.md §1; contract §11.3 D7)
method.segment0: Samples t ≤ m of the zero-Δv run vs the coast run at the same t_s: exact (Object.is) under O-4, the same premise as VT-09 (both propagate the same initial state to the same t_s).
method.afterManeuver: e > 0: no approved transport factor K(e) (open item O-11); the trajectory comparison after m has no tolerance and is NOT evaluated (gap). Only the exact parts and segment 0 are checked.

tolerance.record: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 3 (approved by the owner 2026-11-13) §7 VT-14 (K_r = 14, K_v = 9, e = 0 only; O-11)
tolerance.formula: ‖Δr‖ ≤ M[P_E(t) + v_p(uC_t L_m + δt_res(m)) + P_E(t − m) + (3/2)τ_E,eng(m) v_p (t − m) + K_r P_off(m) + K_v V_off(m)/n]; velocity with g_p, V_E, K_r V_off(m) + K_v n P_off(m)
tolerance.gap: O-11: K_r(e), K_v(e) for e > 0 not derived; no tolerance.
